CFG.progressionRule: Double-progression: when you complete ALL sets at the TOP of the rep range for 2 consecutive sessions on an exercise, add 2.5kg (dumbbells) or 5kg (machines) next session. Never sacrifice form to progress. Week 6 deload: drop 1 set from every exercise, skip all isolation work (curls, lateral raises, calf raises, cable crunch), do main compounds only at 60% normal load. Full week, then resume normal progression.
